scenes.title: From a ticket to merged code

cues.text: Symphony runs coding agents on tickets from Linear or GitHub Issues.
Each ticket gets an agent in its own workspace.
The agent opens a pull request. A merger reviews and merges it.
People stay in control from Tern.

scenes.title: The parts and how they talk

cues.text: Webhooks from the tracker and from GitHub reach the control API.
The API wakes the daemon. The daemon starts a runner Job.
The runner starts omp in a workspace pod.
The pod can reach the gateway, but not the API or Redis.
cues.say: The pod can reach the gateway, but not the API or Red-iss.

cues.text: Redis holds all shared state.
The merger merges pull requests. An assistant bot answers in chat.
Run it on Kubernetes. One VM with k3s is enough.
cues.say: Run it on Kubernetes. One V M with K 3 S is enough.

cues.text: Local mode runs the API, the daemon and the runners in one process.

scenes.title: The ticket state shows the progress

cues.text: A ticket needs the symphony label. On GitHub, the board's Status column is its state.
The agent moves it to In Progress, then to In Review.
The merger sends it to Rework, or to Merging.
After the merge, the ticket goes to Done.
At the turn limit, the same attempt continues.
A failed attempt retries after a backoff.
A person can hold the ticket at any time.
A tracker webhook wakes the daemon in under 3 seconds.
cues.say: A tracker webhook wakes the daemon in under three seconds.

cues.text: The daemon takes a dispatch token. Only that dispatch can write.
The runner makes or reuses the workspace pod.
It gets a GitHub token for the ticket's repositories only.
omp works in turns and streams each event.
It opens a ready pull request and moves the ticket to In Review.

scenes.title: Follow, steer and take over in Tern

cues.text: Tern shows the live sessions on the dashboard.
Open any session as a live chat.
Messages and interrupts reach the agent in under 300 milliseconds.
cues.say: Messages and interrupts reach the agent in under three hundred milliseconds.

cues.text: The agent can ask you a question. It never waits without a limit.
Take over a ticket to work on it with omp on your machine.
Return it, and Symphony continues.
In Slack or Discord, the assistant answers with cited code lines.
Its plans become tickets only after a mapped person confirms.
The CLI and MCP give the same controls.
cues.say: The C L I and M C P give the same controls.

scenes.title: AI review and a deterministic merge train

cues.text: One merger serves every repository, and each has its own train.
Reviewers check the pull request in parallel lanes.
An oracle on a different model checks each finding.
A finding blocks only when both models agree.
A pull request goes back one time. After that, an arbiter decides.
A re-review reads only the new changes.
If CI still runs, the review waits for it.
cues.say: If C I still runs, the review waits for it.

cues.text: The train chains a batch and runs CI on the top only.
cues.say: The train chains a batch and runs C I on the top only.

cues.text: A red batch splits in halves until the bad pull request is alone.
Agents resolve conflicts. The train merges the exact head that CI tested.
cues.say: Agents resolve conflicts. The train merges the exact head that C I tested.

cues.text: When main turns red, the merger opens a ticket.

scenes.title: A model per role, keys on the trusted side

cues.text: The team configuration gives each agent role its own model.
Admins save provider API keys in Tern. The API never returns them.
MCP servers give a role more tools. Their secret headers stay in the gateway.
cues.say: M C P servers give a role more tools. Their secret headers stay in the gateway.

cues.text: A workspace gets only its role's model key, a short-lived GitHub token, a telemetry token and an MCP session token.
cues.say: A workspace gets only its role's model key, a short-lived GitHub token, a telemetry token and an M C P session token.

cues.text: The Linear key, the App key, Slack or Discord tokens, and API tokens stay outside.
Each vendor mock follows the published specification.
With Linear and Slack, real agents passed all 8 scenarios in 278 seconds.
cues.say: With Linear and Slack, real agents passed all eight scenarios in two hundred seventy-eight seconds.

cues.text: With GitHub and Discord, 4 scenarios passed in 183 seconds.
cues.say: With GitHub and Discord, four scenarios passed in one hundred eighty-three seconds.

cues.text: The assistant passed on Slack, on Discord, and with MCP through the gateway.
cues.say: The assistant passed on Slack, on Discord, and with M C P through the gateway.

cues.text: A webhook started a session 44 milliseconds after the ticket.
cues.say: A webhook started a session forty-four milliseconds after the ticket.

scenes.title: Install, then set up step by step

cues.text: Install the API and Redis.
Then run symphony setup, or open Setup in Tern.
Each step is checked before it is saved.
The docs have every step.
